name: Aethir
description: Aethir is a decentralized GPU cloud and DePIN network for AI, gaming, and compute workloads, using the ATH token for staking, rewards, and compute settlement.

name: Agora
description: Agora is a stablecoin infrastructure company behind AUSD, a fully reserved U.S. dollar stablecoin and white-label stablecoin platform for institutions and crypto-native partners.

name: Anemoy
description: Anemoy is a web3-native asset manager, founded 2023, operating as an affiliated asset-management vehicle built on the Centrifuge protocol, tokenizing and distributing real-world-asset funds (short-term Treasuries via the Janus Henderson Anemoy Treasury Fund / JTRSY, and private/direct credit via the Anemoy Tokenized Apollo Diversified Credit Fund / ACRDX) for institutional on-chain access.

name: Candide
description: Candide is an open-source account-abstraction (ERC-4337 / EIP-7702) infrastructure provider. Its main components are Voltaire, a Python/Rust ERC-4337 bundler, and AbstractionKit, a TypeScript SDK for building and sending UserOperations with first-class support for Safe smart accounts, alongside a Safe-based smart contract wallet and a social-recovery module.

name: Chronicle Protocol
description: Chronicle Protocol is a decentralized oracle network, developed by Chronicle Labs Ltd, that originated as MakerDAO's Oracle Core Unit and now provides on-chain price and data feeds (via its "Scribe" mechanism) to DeFi and real-world-asset (RWA) platforms, including continued service to Sky (formerly MakerDAO).

name: Cyfrin
description: Cyfrin is a blockchain security company offering smart contract audits, formal verification, and security tooling, including the CodeHawks competitive-audit marketplace, the Solodit vulnerability/finding database, and the Aderyn open-source Solidity static analyzer. It also runs Cyfrin Updraft, a free smart-contract security education platform.

name: Echelon Prime (Parallel)
description: Echelon Prime is the Toronto-based studio/foundation ecosystem behind Parallel, a sci-fi NFT trading card game (built on Ethereum, in open beta on Epic Games Store) with an associated PRIME governance token, a foundation-run governance body (Emissaries Prime), and a competitive esports league (Parallel Prime League).

name: eOracle
description: eOracle (EO) is an Ethereum-native oracle network that uses EigenLayer restaking to have Ethereum validators/operators attest to off-chain data (initially price feeds) for consumption by DeFi and other on-chain applications.

name: Fuel Network
description: Fuel is a modular execution-layer rollup network (branded "Fuel Ignition" on mainnet) built around a custom parallelized virtual machine (FuelVM) and the Sway smart-contract language, developed by Fuel Labs and governed on-chain by a Fuel Security Council multisig. The FUEL token secures and incentivizes the network alongside the equity of the developing company.

name: Initia
description: Initia is a Layer-1 blockchain paired with an interwoven stack of application-specific optimistic rollups ("Minitias") supporting EVM, MoveVM, and CosmWasm execution environments, aiming to let developers launch custom appchains that share liquidity and security with the L1.

name: Lava Network
description: Lava Network is a decentralized RPC/data-access protocol that routes application, exchange, and AI-agent traffic to independent data providers across many blockchains, incentivized and secured by the LAVA token.

name: Mansa
description: Mansa is a stablecoin-based liquidity and pre-funding provider for payment companies moving money across emerging-market corridors.

name: Nillion
description: Nillion is a "blind computation" privacy-infrastructure network (branded "Petnet"), combining multi-party computation (MPC) and other privacy-enhancing technologies to let applications process data without revealing its contents. Nillion launched its own Cosmos-based mainnet ("nilChain") in March 2025, then announced in January 2026 a migration to Ethereum ("Nillion 2.0"), redefining NIL's role around staking, node-operator access, and payments on Ethereum rather than governance of a standalone chain.

name: Nubit
description: Nubit is a Bitcoin-native data availability protocol developed by Riema Labs Inc., originally positioned as infrastructure that lets Bitcoin-ecosystem applications (BRC-20-style indexers, rollups, modular services) post and verify data with Bitcoin-level security assumptions. Since March 2025 Nubit has repositioned around "Bitcoin Thunderbolt," a proposed Bitcoin base-layer soft-fork upgrade Nubit says it co-developed, aimed at faster transactions and native programmability.

name: Perena
description: Perena is a Solana-based stablecoin liquidity and structured-credit protocol. Its core product, Numeraire, is an automated market maker pooling multiple stablecoins (initially Tether, Circle USDC, and PayPal USD) into a hub-and-spoke pool, issuing a liquidity-provider token (USD*) representing a share of tranched yield across the pool.

name: Pixels
description: Pixels is a farming/exploration-themed multiplayer on-chain game, currently built on Sky Mavis' Ronin blockchain, with an associated PIXEL governance and reward token used for staking, ecosystem rewards, and in-game economy.

name: Plume Network
description: Plume Network is an EVM-compatible RWAfi chain and ecosystem focused on tokenizing real-world assets and making them usable inside DeFi.

name: Skyfire
description: Skyfire (skyfire.xyz) builds the "Agent Trust Stack," payment infrastructure that gives AI agents verifiable identity (the KYA / Know Your Agent protocol) and their own USDC-stablecoin or card-rail-backed wallets so they can autonomously identify themselves and transact without human intervention at time of payment.

name: Spheron Network
description: Spheron Network is a decentralized compute network/marketplace that aggregates GPU, CPU, and Mac-chip capacity from independent providers into a shared pool for AI/ML and other compute workloads, incentivized and governed by the SPON token.

name: Superstate
description: Superstate is a New York-based asset manager building compliant, blockchain-based investment fund products for institutional investors, including tokenized short-term U.S. Treasury and Agency securities funds (USTB), a crypto-basis-trade fund (USCC), and an SEC-registered digital transfer-agent infrastructure (Superstate Services LLC) it is extending toward on-chain issuance of public equities.

name: TACEO
description: TACEO is an Austrian cryptography company building "Private Shared State" infrastructure using coSNARKs, a technique combining multiparty computation (MPC) and zero-knowledge proofs (ZK), so multiple parties can jointly compute on and prove facts about encrypted data without any party seeing the underlying inputs.

name: Term Finance
description: Term Finance is a noncustodial DeFi fixed-rate lending protocol that uses recurring on-chain auctions to match crypto-collateralized borrowers and lenders for fixed terms.

name: Turnkey
description: Turnkey provides non-custodial wallet infrastructure and open-source SDKs for developers to embed crypto wallets and automate on-chain transaction signing. Its core architecture uses AWS Nitro Enclave-based Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) and an open-source "QuorumOS" secure-computing layer to keep private keys inaccessible outside the enclave, with cryptographic attestations intended to make the system's behavior independently verifiable rather than trusted blindly.

name: Wildcat Protocol
description: Wildcat is a permissionless, on-chain undercollateralized lending protocol where borrowers create their own credit markets, setting parameters including reserve ratios, withdrawal cycles, and lender whitelisting, without traditional loan underwriting by the protocol itself.

name: Zodia Custody
description: Zodia Custody is an FCA-registered institutional digital-asset custody, off-venue settlement (Interchange), and staking infrastructure provider, founded in 2020/2021 by SC Ventures (Standard Chartered's innovation arm) and Northern Trust, with Standard Chartered as majority shareholder. As of the research cutoff, Standard Chartered's non-binding offer to acquire the remainder of Zodia Custody's regulated custody business had been accepted by other shareholders/noteholders but had not been confirmed closed.

name: Datagram
description: Coordination and interoperability network for distributed DePIN workloads.

name: Dfns
description: Wallet-as-a-service and digital-asset custody infrastructure for developers, fintechs, and institutions.

name: Nesa
description: Network described by Nesa Labs as a platform for applications, protocols, and smart contracts to integrate artificial intelligence.

name: Neynar
description: Developer infrastructure company providing APIs, hosted hubs, indexes, authentication, webhooks, and data tooling for social protocols.

name: Quadrata
description: Protocol for a privacy-preserving Web3 identity passport and associated compliance attestations.
